units.zh: 葛從周，字通美，濮州鄄城人也。
units.en: Ge Congzhou, styled Tongmei, came from Juancheng in Puzhou.
units.literal: Ge Congzhou, style name Tongmei, was a native of Juancheng in Pu prefecture.

units.zh: 曾祖阮，祖遇賢，父簡，累贈兵部尚書。
units.en: His line reached posthumous Minister of War through his father Jian.
units.literal: Great-grandfather Ruan, grandfather Yu Xian, father Jian—repeatedly posthumously made Minister of War.

units.zh: 從周少豁達，有智略，初入黃巢軍，漸至軍校。
units.en: Open and shrewd in youth, he joined Huang Chao and rose to guard officer.
units.literal: Congzhou in youth was open and generous, had wisdom and stratagem; he first entered Huang Chao's army and gradually reached guard officer.

units.zh: 唐中和四年三月，太祖大破巢軍於王滿渡，從周與霍存、張歸霸昆弟相率來降。
units.en: Tang Zhonghe 4, month 3, after the Founder crushed Chao at Wangman Ford, Congzhou surrendered with Huo Cun and the Zhang brothers.
units.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Zhonghe of Tang the Founder greatly defeated Chao's army at Wangman Ford; Congzhou with Huo Cun and Zhang Guiba and his brothers in succession came to surrender.

units.zh: 七月，從太祖屯兵於西華，破蔡賊王夏寨。
units.en: Month 7 he camped at Xihua and broke Cai rebel Wang Xia's camp.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Founder encamped troops at Xihua and broke Cai bandit Wang Xia's stockade.

units.zh: 太祖臨陣馬踣，賊眾來追甚急，從周扶太祖上馬，與賊軍格鬥，傷面，矢中於肱，身被數槍，奮命以衛太祖。
units.en: When the Founder's horse fell under pursuit, Congzhou mounted him, fought on wounded by face, arm, and spears, and saved his life.
units.literal: The Founder in battle his horse fell; bandit masses came pressing in pursuit very urgently; Congzhou helped the Founder mount, grappled with the bandit army, wounded his face, an arrow struck his upper arm, his body received several spears, and he exhausted his life to guard the Founder.

units.zh: 賴張延壽回馬轉鬥，從周與太祖俱免，退軍溵水。
units.en: Zhang Yanshou's countercharge let Congzhou and the Founder escape to Yin River.
units.literal: Relying on Zhang Yanshou wheeling his horse and turning to fight, Congzhou and the Founder both escaped; the army withdrew to Yin River.

units.zh: 諸將並削職，惟擢從周、延壽為大校。
units.en: Other generals were demoted; only Congzhou and Yanshou were promoted.
units.literal: The generals all had offices reduced; only Congzhou and Yanshou were promoted to great colonels.

units.zh: 其從入長葛、靈井，大敗蔡賊，至斤溝、淝河，殺鐵林三千人，獲九寨都虞候王涓。
units.en: He helped take Changge and Lingjing, killed three thousand Iron Forest troops at Fei River, and captured commander Wang Juan.
units.literal: Following in to enter Changge and Lingjing, he greatly defeated Cai bandits; reaching Jingou and Fei River he killed three thousand Iron Forest troops and captured nine-stockade commander Wang Juan.

units.zh: 太祖遣郭言募兵於陝州，有黃花子賊據於溫穀，從周擊破之。
units.en: He broke the Yellow Flower bandits at Wengu while Guo Yan recruited at Shan.
units.literal: The Founder sent Guo Yan to recruit troops at Shan prefecture; Yellow Flower bandits held Wengu; Congzhou broke and defeated them.

units.zh: 又破秦賢之眾於滎陽，尋佐朱珍收兵於淄、青間。
units.en: He beat Qin Xian at Xingyang and aided Zhu Zhen in Zi and Qing.
units.literal: He again defeated Qin Xian's masses at Xingyang and soon aided Zhu Zhen in gathering troops between Zi and Qing.

units.zh: 時兗州齊克護軍於任城，從周敗之，擒其將呂全真。
units.en: He defeated Qi Kehu at Rencheng and captured Lü Quanzhen.
units.literal: At that time Yanzhou's Qi Kehu had troops at Rencheng; Congzhou defeated him and captured his general Lü Quanzhen.

units.zh: 淄人不受制，復與之戰，獲其驍將鞏約。
units.en: When Zi resisted he fought again and took the fierce Gong Yue.
units.literal: Zi people would not submit; he fought them again and took their fierce general Gong Yue.

units.zh: 會青州以步騎萬餘人列三寨於金嶺，以厄要害，從周與朱珍大殲其眾，擄其將楊昭範五人而還。
units.en: He and Zhu Zhen annihilated Qing troops at Jin Ridge and captured Yang Zhaofan and five generals.
units.literal: When Qing prefecture with more than ten thousand foot and horse arrayed three stockades at Jin Ridge to choke the crucial point, Congzhou with Zhu Zhen greatly annihilated their masses, captured their general Yang Zhaofan and five men, and returned.

units.zh: 至大梁，不解甲，徑至板橋擊蔡賊，破盧瑭寨；
units.en: Without resting at Daliang he struck Cai at Banqiao and broke Lu Tang's camp;
units.literal: Reaching Daliang, not doffing armor, he went straight to Banqiao to strike Cai bandits and broke Lu Tang's stockade;

units.zh: 瑭自溺而死，又於赤岡殺蔡軍二萬餘人。
units.en: Tang drowned; at Red Mound he killed twenty thousand Cai troops.
units.literal: Tang drowned himself; again at Red Mound he killed more than twenty thousand Cai troops.

units.zh: 從討謝殷於亳州，擒之。
units.en: He captured Xie Yin at Bozhou.
units.literal: Following in the attack on Xie Yin at Bozhou, he captured him.

units.zh: 回襲曹州，擄刺史丘宏禮以歸。
units.en: Raiding Cao he took commissioner Qiu Hongli.
units.literal: Returning to raid Cao prefecture he captured military commissioner Qiu Hongli and returned.

units.zh: 與兗、鄆軍遇於臨濮之劉橋，殺數萬人，朱瑄、朱瑾僅以身免，擒都將鄒務卿已下五十人。
units.en: At Liu Bridge he killed tens of thousands; Zhu Xuan and Jin barely escaped; he took fifty officers including Zou Wuqing.
units.literal: Meeting Yan and Yanzhou troops at Liu Bridge in Linpu he killed tens of thousands; Zhu Xuan and Zhu Jin barely escaped with their bodies; he captured commander Zou Wuqing and below fifty men.

units.zh: 從太祖至範縣，復與朱瑄戰，擄尹萬榮等三人，遂平濮州。
units.en: At Fan he beat Zhu Xuan, took Yin Wanrong and others, and pacified Pu.
units.literal: Following the Founder to Fan county he again fought Zhu Xuan, captured Yin Wanrong and three others, and then pacified Pu prefecture.

units.zh: 未幾，與朱珍擊蔡賊於陳、亳間，獲都將石璠。
units.en: With Zhu Zhen he beat Cai between Chen and Bo and took Shi Fan.
units.literal: Before long with Zhu Zhen he struck Cai bandits between Chen and Bo and captured commander Shi Fan.

units.zh: 文德元年，魏博軍亂，樂從訓來告急，從太祖渡河，拔黎陽、李固、臨河等鎮，至內黃，破魏軍萬餘眾，獲其將周儒等十人。
units.en: Wende 1 he crossed the river with the Founder, took Li Yang and other posts, and at Neihuang captured Zhou Ru and ten Wei officers.
units.literal: In Wende year 1 Wei-Bo army mutinied; Le Congxun came reporting urgent distress; following the Founder across the river he took Li Yang, Liguo, Linhe, and other posts; reaching Neihuang he broke more than ten thousand Wei troops and captured their generals Zhou Ru and ten men.

units.zh: 李罕之引並人圍張全義於河陽，從周與丁會、張存敬、牛存節率兵赴援，大破並軍，殺蕃漢二萬人，解河陽之圍，以功表授檢校工部尚書。
units.en: He relieved Heyang from Li Hanzhi's Jin siege, killed twenty thousand, and became honorary Minister of Works.
units.literal: Li Hanzhi led Jin men to besiege Zhang Quanyi at Heyang; Congzhou with Ding Hui, Zhang Cunjing, and Niu Cunjie led troops to the rescue, greatly defeated Jin troops, killed twenty thousand Han and barbarian, lifted Heyang's siege, and for merit was memorialized honorary Minister of Works.

units.zh: 從朱珍討徐州，撥豐縣，敗時溥於吳康，得其輜重，加檢校刑部尚書。
units.en: At Xuzhou he took Feng, beat Shi Pu at Wukang, and became honorary Minister of Punishments.
units.literal: Following Zhu Zhen to attack Xuzhou he took Feng county, defeated Shi Pu at Wukang, obtained his baggage train, and was added honorary Minister of Punishments.

units.zh: 佐龐師古討孫儒於淮南，略地至廬、壽、滁等州，下天長、高郵，破邵伯堰。
units.en: In Huainan with Pang Shigu he took Lu, Shou, Chu, Tianchang, and Gaoyou and broke Shaobo Dam.
units.literal: Aiding Pang Shigu against Sun Ru in Huainan he swept territory to Lu, Shou, and Chu prefectures, took Tianchang and Gaoyou, and broke Shaobo Dam.

units.zh: 回軍攻濠州，殺刺史魏勳，得餉船十艘。
units.en: He took Haozhou, killed Wei Xun, and seized ten supply boats.
units.literal: Returning he attacked Haozhou, killed military commissioner Wei Xun, and obtained ten supply boats.

units.zh: 大順元年八月，並帥圍潞州，太祖遣從周率敢死之士，夜銜枚犯圍而入，會王師不利於馬牢川，即棄上黨而歸。
units.en: Dashun 1, month 8, he slipped into besieged Lu; after defeat at Malaichuan the army abandoned Shangdang.
units.literal: In the eighth month of Dashun year 1 Jin commander besieged Lu prefecture; the Founder sent Congzhou with dare-death troops who by night held branches in their mouths and broke through the encirclement to enter; when the royal army was unfavorable at Malaichuan he then abandoned Shangdang and returned.

units.zh: 其年十二月，與丁會諸將討魏州，連收十邑。
units.en: Month 12 he and Ding Hui took ten Wei districts.
units.literal: That year, twelfth month, with Ding Hui and generals he attacked Wei prefecture and in succession took ten districts.

units.zh: 明年正月，大破魏軍於永定橋，魏軍五敗，斬首萬餘級。
units.en: Month 1 next year he routed Wei five times at Yongding Bridge with ten thousand heads.
units.literal: The next year, first month, he greatly defeated Wei troops at Yongding Bridge; Wei army five defeats, beheading more than ten thousand.

units.zh: 十月，佐丁會攻宿州，從周壅水灌其城，刺史張筠以郡降。
units.en: Month 10 he flooded Suzhou and Zhang Yun surrendered.
units.literal: In the tenth month aiding Ding Hui in attacking Suzhou, Congzhou dammed water to flood the city; military commissioner Zhang Yun surrendered the prefecture.

units.zh: 從討兗州，破朱瑾之軍於馬溝。
units.en: He broke Zhu Jin at Magou in the Yanzhou campaign.
units.literal: Following in the attack on Yanzhou he broke Zhu Jin's army at Magou.

units.zh: 景福二年二月，與諸將大破徐、兗之兵於石佛山。
units.en: Jingfu 2, month 2, he crushed Xu and Yan troops at Stone Buddha Mountain.
units.literal: In the second month of Jingfu year 2 with generals he greatly defeated Xu and Yanzhou troops at Stone Buddha Mountain.

units.zh: 八月，與龐師古同攻兗州。
units.en: Month 8 he besieged Yanzhou with Pang Shigu.
units.literal: In the eighth month with Pang Shigu he jointly attacked Yanzhou.

units.zh: 乾寧元年三月，軍至新泰縣，朱瑾令都將張約、李胡椒率三千人來拒戰，師古遣從周、張存敬掩襲，生擒張約、李胡椒等都將數十人。
units.en: Qianning 1, month 3, he ambushed and captured Zhang Yue, Li Hujiao, and dozens of Yan officers at Xintai.
units.literal: In the third month of Qianning year 1 the army reached Xintai county; Zhu Jin ordered commander Zhang Yue and Li Hujiao to lead three thousand men to resist; Shigu sent Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing in ambush strike and captured Zhang Yue, Li Hujiao, and several tens of commanders alive.

units.zh: 二年十月，圍兗州，兗人不出，從周詐揚言並人、鄆人來救，即引軍趨高吳，夜半卻潛歸寨。
units.en: Besieging Yan he feigned a Jin-Yan relief march, then doubled back at night.
units.literal: In the tenth month of year 2 besieging Yanzhou, Yan people did not come out; Congzhou falsely proclaimed Jin and Yanzhou men coming to rescue, then led troops toward Gaowu; at midnight he secretly returned to camp.

units.zh: 朱瑾果出兵攻外壕，我軍士突出，掩殺千餘人，生擒都將張漢筠。
units.en: Jin sallied; Congzhou ambushed and killed a thousand and captured Zhang Hanyun.
units.literal: Zhu Jin indeed sent troops to attack the outer moat; our soldiers burst out, ambushed and killed more than a thousand, and captured commander Zhang Hanyun alive.

units.zh: 從周累立戰功，自懷州刺史曆曹、宿二州刺史，累遷檢校左僕射。
units.en: He rose from Huai to Cao and Su commissioner to honorary Left Vice Director.
units.literal: Congzhou repeatedly established battle merit; from Huai prefecture military commissioner he passed through Cao and Su prefecture military commissioners, repeatedly rising to honorary Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 三年五月，並帥以大軍侵魏，遣其子落落率二千騎屯洹水，從周以馬步二千人擊之，殺戮殆盡，擒落落於陣，並帥號泣而去。
units.en: Month 5, year 3, he destroyed Luoluo's two thousand cavalry at Huan River and captured Keyong's son.
units.literal: In the fifth month of year 3 the Jin commander with a great army invaded Wei and sent his son Luoluo with two thousand cavalry to camp at Huan River; Congzhou with two thousand horse and foot struck them, slaughter nearly all, and captured Luoluo in the formation; the Jin commander wailed and left.

units.zh: 遂自洹水與龐師古渡河擊鄆。
units.en: He crossed from Huan with Pang Shigu to attack Yan.
units.literal: He then from Huan River with Pang Shigu crossed the river to attack Yan.

units.zh: 四年正月，下之。
units.en: Month 1, year 4, Yan fell.
units.literal: In the first month of year 4 he took it.

units.zh: 從周乘勝伐兗，會朱瑾出師在徐境，其將康懷英以城降。
units.en: Pressing Yan he took it when Kang Huaiying surrendered while Jin was away.
units.literal: Congzhou took victory in stride to attack Yan; when Zhu Jin marched out on campaign in Xu territory his general Kang Huaiying surrendered the city.

units.zh: 以功授兗州留後、檢校司空。
units.en: He became Yan acting commissioner and honorary Grand Marshal.
units.literal: For merit he was appointed Yanzhou acting commissioner and honorary Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 復領兵萬餘人渡淮討楊行密，至濠州，聞龐師古清口之敗，遽班師。
units.en: Crossing the Huai against Yang Xingmi he withdrew on news of Qingkou.
units.literal: Again he led more than ten thousand troops across the Huai to attack Yang Xingmi; reaching Haozhou he heard of Pang Shigu's defeat at Qingkou and hastily withdrew the army.

units.zh: 光化元年四月，率師經略山東，時並帥以大軍屯邢、洺，從周至钜鹿與並軍遇，大破之，並帥遁走。
units.en: Guanghua 1, month 4, he routed the Jin army at Julu in Shandong.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Guanghua year 1 he led troops to pacify Shandong; at that time the Jin commander with a great army camped at Xing and Ming; Congzhou at Julu met Jin troops and greatly defeated them; the Jin commander fled.

units.zh: 我軍追襲至青山口，數日之內，邢、洺、磁三州連下，斬首二萬級，獲將吏一百五十人，即以從周兼領邢州留後。
units.en: He pursued to Qingshan and took Xing, Ming, and Ci with twenty thousand heads.
units.literal: Our army pursued to Qingshan Pass; within several days Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures fell in succession; beheading twenty thousand, capturing a hundred fifty officers and clerks; Congzhou was made concurrent Xingzhou acting commissioner.

units.zh: 十月，復破並軍五千騎於張公橋。
units.en: Month 10 he beat five thousand Jin horse at Zhanggong Bridge.
units.literal: In the tenth month he again defeated five thousand Jin cavalry at Zhanggong Bridge.

units.zh: 晉將李嗣昭急攻邢州，陣於城門外，從周大破之，擒蕃將賁金鐵、慕容騰百餘人。
units.en: The Jin general Li Sizhao pressed the attack on Xingzhou and formed his ranks outside the city gate. Congzhou routed him, capturing the tribal commanders Ben Jintie and Murong Teng along with more than a hundred men.
units.literal: Jin general Li Sizhao pressed his attack on Xingzhou and drew up outside the city gate. Congzhou routed him and captured the tribal commanders Ben Jintie and Murong Teng, together with more than a hundred men.

units.zh: 二年春，幽州劉仁恭率軍十萬寇魏州，屠貝郡。
units.en: Spring year 2 Liu Rengong ravaged Wei and slaughtered Bei.
units.literal: In spring of year 2 Youzhou's Liu Rengong led a hundred thousand army to raid Wei prefecture and slaughter Bei prefecture.

units.zh: 從周自邢台馳入魏州，燕軍突上水關，攻館陶門。
units.en: He galloped from Xingtai as Yan stormed Guantao Gate.
units.literal: Congzhou from Xingtai galloped into Wei prefecture; Yan army suddenly rushed the upper water gate and attacked Guantao Gate.

units.zh: 從周與賀德倫率五百騎出戰，謂門者曰：「前有敵，不可返顧！」
units.en: With He Delun he charged out, telling the gatekeepers, "Enemies ahead—do not turn back!"
units.literal: Congzhou with He Delun led five hundred cavalry out to battle and told the gatekeepers: "Enemies ahead—you must not look back!"

units.zh: 命闔其門。
units.en: He had the gates shut.
units.literal: He ordered the gates shut.

units.zh: 從周等極力死戰，大敗燕人，擒都將薛突厥、王郃郎等。
units.en: They fought to the death and captured Xue Tujue and Wang Helang.
units.literal: Congzhou and the rest exhausted strength in death battle, greatly defeated Yan men, and captured commanders Xue Tujue and Wang Helang and others.

units.zh: 翌日，破其八寨，追擊至臨清，劉仁恭走滄州，從周授宣義軍行軍司馬。
units.en: Next day he broke eight camps, pursued to Linqing, and Rengong fled to Cang.
units.literal: The next day he broke their eight stockades, pursued to Linqing; Liu Rengong fled to Cangzhou; Congzhou was appointed Xuanyi army campaign deputy.

units.zh: 五月，並人討李罕之於潞州，太祖以丁會代罕之，令從周馳入上黨。
units.en: Month 5 he galloped into Shangdang as Jin attacked Lu.
units.literal: In the fifth month Jin men attacked Li Hanzhi at Lu prefecture; the Founder made Ding Hui replace Hanzhi and ordered Congzhou to gallop into Shangdang.

units.zh: 七月，並人陷澤州，太祖召從周，令賀德倫守潞州，德倫等尋棄城而歸。
units.en: Month 7 Ze fell; He Delun abandoned Lu despite orders.
units.literal: In the seventh month Jin men took Ze prefecture; the Founder summoned Congzhou and ordered He Delun to guard Lu prefecture; Delun and the rest soon abandoned the city and returned.

units.zh: 三年四月，領軍討滄州，先攻德州，下之。
units.en: Month 4, year 3, he took De then marched on Cang.
units.literal: In the fourth month of year 3 he led troops to attack Cangzhou, first attacking De prefecture and taking it.

units.zh: 及進攻浮陽，幽州劉仁恭大舉來援。
units.en: Besieging Fuyang he faced Liu Rengong's great relief army.
units.literal: When advancing to attack Fuyang, Youzhou's Liu Rengong came in great force to aid.

units.zh: 時都監蔣元暉謂諸將曰：「吾王命我護軍，志在攻取，今燕帥來赴，不可外戰，當縱其入壁，聚食囷廩，力屈糧盡，必可取也。」
units.en: Overseer Jiang Yuanhui told the generals, "Our prince ordered me to protect the army with intent to attack and take. Now the Yan commander comes to the rescue—we cannot fight outside. We should let them enter the walls, gather and eat from the granaries, and when strength is spent and grain exhausted they can surely be taken."
units.literal: At that time overseer Jiang Yuanhui told the generals: "Our prince ordered me to protect the army with intent to attack and take; now the Yan commander comes to the rescue—we cannot fight outside; we should let them enter the walls, gather and eat from granaries, and when strength is spent and grain exhausted they can surely be taken."

units.zh: 從周對曰：「兵在機，機在上將，非督護所言也。」
units.en: Congzhou replied, "War lies in opportunity; opportunity lies in the chief general—not what the overseer says."
units.literal: Congzhou replied: "War lies in opportunity; opportunity lies in the chief general—not what the overseer says."

units.zh: 乃令張存敬、氏叔琮守其寨。
units.en: He left Zhang Cunjing and Shi Shuzong to hold camp.
units.literal: He then ordered Zhang Cunjing and Shi Shuzong to guard the stockades.

units.zh: 從周逆戰於乾寧軍老鴉堤，大破燕軍，斬首三萬，獲將佐馬慎交已下百餘人，奪馬三千匹。
units.en: At Old Crow Embankment he killed thirty thousand Yan troops and took three thousand horses.
units.literal: Congzhou met battle at Qianning army Old Crow Embankment, greatly defeated Yan army, beheaded thirty thousand, captured generals and aides Ma Shenjiao and below a hundred men, and seized three thousand horses.

units.zh: 八月，並人攻邢、洺，從太祖破之。
units.en: Month 8 he beat Jin at Xing and Ming with the Founder.
units.literal: In the eighth month Jin men attacked Xing and Ming; following the Founder he defeated them.

units.zh: 從周追襲至青山口，斬首五千級，獲其將王郃郎、楊師悅等，得馬千匹，表授檢校太保，兼徐州兩使留後，尋為兗州節度使。
units.en: Pursuing to Qingshan he took five thousand heads and became Yan commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian.
units.literal: Congzhou pursued to Qingshan Pass, beheaded five thousand, captured their generals Wang Helang, Yang Shiyue, and others, obtained a thousand horses, was memorialized honorary Grand Guardian, concurrent Xu two-circuits acting commissioner, soon Yanzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 天復元年三月，與氏叔琮討太原，從周以兗、鄆之眾，自土門路入，與諸軍會於晉陽城下，以糧運不給，班師。
units.en: Tianfu 1, month 3, with Shi Shuzong he marched on Taiyuan; Congzhou led the Yan and Yun forces in by the Tumen route, joined the armies below Jinyang, and withdrew when supplies failed.
units.literal: In the third month of Tianfu year 1, with Shi Shuzong he campaigned against Taiyuan; Congzhou led the Yan and Yun forces in by the Tumen route, joined the armies beneath Jinyang, and withdrew when grain transport failed.

units.zh: 頃之，從周染疾，會青州將劉鄩陷兗州，太祖命討之，遂力疾臨戎。
units.en: Soon after he fell ill; when Liu Xun of Qingzhou took Yanzhou, the Founder ordered him to attack and he took the field despite illness.
units.literal: Soon after Congzhou fell ill; when Qingzhou general Liu Xun took Yanzhou, the Founder ordered him to attack and he took the field despite illness.

units.zh: 三年十一月，鄩舉城降，以功授檢校太傅。
units.en: Month 11, Tianfu 3, Xun surrendered the city and Congzhou was made honorary Grand Tutor for the merit.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of year 3, Xun surrendered the city; for merit he was made honorary Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 太祖以從周抱疾既久，命康懷英代之，授左金吾上將軍，以風恙不任朝謁，改右衛上將軍致仕。
units.en: The Founder, since Congzhou's illness had long lingered, had Kang Huaiying replace him and made Congzhou Left Golden Crow general; wind ailment kept him from court, so he was changed to Right Guard general and retired.
units.literal: The Founder, since Congzhou's illness had long lingered, ordered Kang Huaiying to replace him and made Congzhou General of the Left Golden Crow Guards; because wind ailment prevented court attendance, he was changed to General of the Right Guard and retired.

units.zh: 養疾偃師縣亳邑鄉之別墅。
units.en: He nursed his illness at a villa in Boyi township, Yanshi county.
units.literal: He nursed his illness at a villa in Boyi township, Yanshi county.

units.zh: 頃之，授太子太師，依前致仕。
units.en: Soon after he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, still retired as before.
units.literal: Soon after he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, still retired as before.

units.zh: 末帝即位，製授潞州節度使，令坐食其俸，加開府儀同三司、檢校太師、兼侍中，封陳留郡王，累食邑至七千戶，命近臣賚旌節就別墅以賜之。
units.en: When the Last Emperor came to the throne, an edict made him Lu commissioner with seated salary, added the Golden Pocket and Honored Equal to the Three Dukes, honorary Grand Preceptor, and Palace Secretary, enfeoffed him as Prince of Chenliu with a fief reaching seven thousand households, and sent a close official with banners and credentials to his villa.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor came to the throne, an edict appointed him military commissioner of Lu with seated salary, added Bearer of the Golden Pocket with Honored Equal to the Three Dukes, honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Secretary, enfeoffed him as Prince of Chenliu commandery with cumulative food domain to seven thousand households, and ordered a close official to bring banners and credentials to his villa as gifts.

units.zh: 貞明初，卒於家。
units.en: Early in Zhenming he died at home.
units.literal: Early in Zhenming he died at home.

units.zh: 冊贈太尉。
units.en: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal.
units.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 謝彥章，許州人。
units.en: Xie Yanzhang came from Xu prefecture.
units.literal: Xie Yanzhang was a Xu prefecture man.

units.zh: 幼事從周為養父，從周憐其敏慧，教以兵法，常以千錢於大盤中，布其行陣偏伍之狀，示以出沒進退之節，彥章盡得其訣。
units.en: Adopted by Congzhou, he learned warfare on a tray of coins modeling formations.
units.literal: In youth he served Congzhou as adopted father; Congzhou pitied his quick intelligence, taught him military arts, often used a thousand cash on a great tray to array battle formations and partial units, showing advance-and-retreat rhythm; Yanzhang fully obtained the secrets.

units.zh: 及壯，事太祖為騎將。
units.en: Grown, he served the Founder as cavalry officer.
units.literal: When grown he served the Founder as a cavalry officer.

units.zh: 末帝嗣位，用為兩京馬軍都軍使，累與晉軍接戰有功，尋領河陽節度使。
units.en: Under the Last Emperor he commanded both capitals' cavalry, won against Jin, and became Heyang commissioner.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor succeeded, he was used as both-capitals horse army overall commander; repeatedly fighting Jin troops he had merit; soon he held Heyang military commission.

units.zh: 及從周卒，臨喪行服，躬預葬事，時人義之。
units.en: He mourned Congzhou in full filial rites and was praised.
units.literal: When Congzhou died he attended the mourning wearing funeral garb and personally took part in burial; men of the time praised the righteousness.

units.zh: 彥章後為許州節度使、檢校太傅。
units.en: Later he was Xu commissioner and honorary Grand Tutor.
units.literal: Yanzhang later was Xu military commissioner and honorary Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 貞明四年冬，滑州節度使賀瑰為北面招討使，彥章為排陣使，同領大軍，駐於行台寨，與晉人對壘。
units.en: Zhenming 4 winter he and He Gui camped at Xingtai against the Jin army.
units.literal: In winter of Zhenming year 4 Huazhou military commissioner He Gui was northern campaign commander; Yanzhang was array commander; together they led the great army, camped at Xingtai Stockade, and faced Jin men in opposing camps.

units.zh: 彥章時領騎軍與之挑戰，晉人或望我軍行陣整肅，則相謂曰：「必兩京太傅在此也。」
units.en: Yanzhang led cavalry to challenge them; Jin troops seeing our formations would say to one another, "The two-capitals Grand Tutor must be here."
units.literal: Yanzhang then led cavalry to challenge them; Jin men sometimes seeing our army's formations neat and stern would say to one another: "The two-capitals Grand Tutor must be here."

units.zh: 不敢以名呼，其為敵人所憚如此。
units.en: They would not speak his name aloud.
units.literal: They did not dare call him by name; such was the enemy's fear of him.

units.zh: 是時咸謂賀瑰能將步軍，彥章能領騎士，既名聲相軋，故瑰心忌之。
units.en: He Gui resented Yanzhang because both were famed commanders.
units.literal: At that time all said He Gui could command foot soldiers and Yanzhang could lead cavalry; since fame rubbed against each other, Gui therefore resented him in heart.

units.zh: 一日，與瑰同設伏於郊外，瑰指一方地謂彥章曰：「此地岡阜隆起，中央坦夷，好列柵之所。」
units.en: One day Gui pointed at a plot of ground and told Yanzhang, "This mound rises and the center is level—good for setting palisades."
units.literal: One day with Gui he jointly set ambush in the suburbs; Gui pointed at one plot of ground and told Yanzhang: "This place's mound rises and the center is level—good for setting palisades."

units.zh: 尋而晉人舍之，故瑰疑彥章與晉人通；
units.en: Jin avoided it; Gui suspected Yanzhang of collusion;
units.literal: Soon Jin men abandoned it; therefore Gui suspected Yanzhang communicated with Jin men;

units.zh: 又瑰欲速戰，彥章欲持重以老敵人，瑰益疑之。
units.en: Gui wanted battle; Yanzhang wanted delay; suspicion grew.
units.literal: Again Gui wished swift battle; Yanzhang wished to hold weight and wear out the enemy; Gui's suspicion increased.

units.zh: 會為行營馬步都虞候朱珪所誣，瑰遂與珪邦協謀，因享士伏甲以殺彥章及濮州刺史孟審澄、別將侯溫裕等於軍，以謀叛聞。
units.en: Zhu Gui slandered him; at a feast Gui ambushed and killed Yanzhang, Meng Shencheng, and Hou Wenyu as traitors.
units.literal: When camp horse-and-foot chief commandant Zhu Gui slandered him, Gui then with Gui conspired, and at a feast for officers set hidden armor and killed Yanzhang, Bozhou military commissioner Meng Shencheng, and separate commander Hou Wenyu and others in the army, reporting it as plotting rebellion.

units.zh: 晉王聞之，喜曰：「彼將帥如是，亡無日矣。」
units.en: The Prince of Jin rejoiced, "With generals like that they will soon fall."
units.literal: The Prince of Jin heard it and said with pleasure: "Their generals like this—ruin will come in no long day."

units.zh: 審澄、溫裕亦善將騎軍，然所領不過三千騎；
units.en: Shencheng and Wenyu led only three thousand horse;
units.literal: Shencheng and Wenyu were also good at commanding cavalry, yet their commands did not exceed three thousand horse;

units.zh: 多而益辦，惟彥章有焉。
units.en: only Yanzhang commanded more with equal skill.
units.literal: many yet more able—only Yanzhang had it.

units.zh: 將略之外，好優禮儒士。
units.en: Beyond tactics he honored scholars.
units.literal: Beyond generalship he loved to honor Ruist gentlemen.

units.zh: 與晉人對壘於河上，恒褒衣博帶，動皆由禮，或臨敵禦眾，則肅然有上將之威。
units.en: On the river he wore scholar's robes yet showed a commander's stern majesty in battle.
units.literal: Facing Jin men in opposing camps on the river he always wore loose robes and broad belt; every movement followed ritual; sometimes facing the enemy controlling the masses he was stern with a great commander's majesty.

units.zh: 每敦陣整旅，左旋右抽，雖風馳雨驟，亦無以喻其迅捷也，故當時騎士鹹樂為用。
units.en: His cavalry maneuvers were swifter than storm; horsemen loved to follow him.
units.literal: Each time he arrayed ranks and regulated brigades, wheeling left and striking right—even wind gallop and rain burst could not compare to his swiftness; therefore cavalrymen of the time all delighted to serve under him.

units.zh: 及其遇害，人皆惜之。
units.en: His murder was widely mourned.
units.literal: When he met harm people all mourned him.

units.zh: 胡真，江陵人也。
units.en: Hu Zhen came from Jiangling.
units.literal: Hu Zhen was a Jiangling man.

units.zh: 體貌洪壯，長七尺，善騎射，少為縣吏。
units.en: Seven feet tall and a master archer, he began as a county clerk.
units.literal: His physique was huge and strong, seven feet tall, skilled at mounted archery; in youth he was a county clerk.

units.zh: 及在巢寇中，寇推為名將，隨巢涉淮、浙，陷許、洛，入長安。
units.en: In Huang Chao's ranks he became a famed general and entered Chang'an with the rebels.
units.literal: When in Chao's banditry the bandits pushed him as a famous general; he followed Chao across Huai and Zhe, took Xu and Luo, and entered Chang'an.

units.zh: 及太祖以眾歸唐，真時為元從都將，
units.en: When the Founder submitted to Tang, Zhen was an original-follower commander,
units.literal: When the Founder with masses returned to Tang, Zhen was then original-follower overall commander,

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》云：溫見巢兵勢日蹙，知其將亡，親將胡真、謝瞳勸溫歸國。）〉
units.en: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says: Wen, seeing Chao's power daily wane and knowing he would fall, was urged by his trusted generals Hu Zhen and Xie Tong to return to the Tang state.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 says: Wen saw Chao's military power daily pinched, knew he would perish, and his trusted generals Hu Zhen and Xie Tong urged Wen to return to the state.)〉

units.zh: 從至梁苑，表授檢校刑部尚書，頻從破巢、蔡於陳、鄭間。
units.en: At Liang Garden he became honorary Minister of Punishments and fought Chao and Cai.
units.literal: Following to Liang Garden he was memorialized honorary Minister of Punishments and repeatedly followed in breaking Chao and Cai between Chen and Zheng.

units.zh: 尋以奇兵襲取滑州，乃署為滑州節度留後，復表為鄭滑節度使、檢校右僕射。
units.en: He seized Huazhou and became Zheng-Hua commissioner.
units.literal: Soon with strange troops he raided and took Huazhou and was appointed Huazhou military acting commissioner; again memorialized Zheng-Hua military commissioner and honorary Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 數年，征為右金吾衛大將軍，俄拜寧遠軍節度使、容州刺史、檢校太保。
units.en: Later he was Golden Guard general, then Ningyuan and Rong commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian.
units.literal: After several years he was summoned as Right Golden Guard great general; soon he was made Ningyuan army military commissioner, Rong prefecture military commissioner, and honorary Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 卒贈太傅。
units.en: He was posthumously named Grand Tutor.
units.literal: On death he was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 張歸霸，字正臣，清河人。
units.en: Zhang Guiba, styled Zhengchen, came from Qinghe.
units.literal: Zhang Guiba, style name Zhengchen, was a Qinghe man.

units.zh: 祖進言，陽穀令。
units.en: His grandfather Jinyan was magistrate of Yanggu.
units.literal: Grandfather Jinyan was Yanggu county magistrate.

units.zh: 父實，亦有宦緒。
units.en: His father Shi also held office.
units.literal: Father Shi also had an official pedigree.

units.zh: 少倜儻，好兵術。
units.en: Young, he was bold and loved warfare.
units.literal: In youth he was unconventional, loved military arts.

units.zh: 唐乾符中，寇盜蜂起，歸霸率昆弟三人棄家投黃巢，頗以勇略聞。
units.en: In Qianfu he and three brothers joined Huang Chao for their fighting fame.
units.literal: In Qianfu of Tang bandits and robbers swarmed; Guiba led three brothers to abandon home and join Huang Chao, quite known for courage and stratagem.

units.zh: 巢陷長安，遂署為左番功臣。
units.en: When Chao took Chang'an he became Left Merit Baron.
units.literal: When Chao took Chang'an he was appointed Left Merit Baron.

units.zh: 中和中，巢領徒走宛丘。
units.en: In Zhonghe Chao fled to Wankiu.
units.literal: In Zhonghe, Chao led followers to flee to Wankiu.

units.zh: 時太祖在汴，奉詔南討，巢黨日窘，歸霸昆仲與葛從周、李讜等相率來降，尋補宣武軍劇職。
units.en: At Bian Guiba and his brothers surrendered with Congzhou and Li Rang and joined the Xuanyi army.
units.literal: At that time the Founder was at Bian, received edict for southern campaign; Chao's party daily pressed; Guiba and his brothers with Ge Congzhou, Li Rang, and others in succession came to surrender; soon he was supplemented to Xuanyi army key posts.

units.zh: 光啟二年，與蔡將張存戰於盧氏。
units.en: Guangqi 2 he fought Zhang Cun at Lushi.
units.literal: In Guangqi year 2 he fought Cai general Zhang Cun at Lushi.

units.zh: 三年夏，又與蔡將盧瑭戰於雙丘，復與秦宗賢戰於萬勝，皆敗而殲之。
units.en: Year 3 summer he destroyed Lu Tang at Shuangqiu and Qin Zongxian at Wansheng.
units.literal: In summer of year 3 he again fought Cai general Lu Tang at Shuangqiu and again fought Qin Zongxian at Wansheng—all defeated and annihilated.

units.zh: 翌日，宗權遣將張郅來寇，列寨於赤堈。
units.en: Next day Zhang Zhi of Cai camped at Chijin.
units.literal: The next day Zongquan sent general Zhang Zhi to raid, arraying stockades at Chijin.

units.zh: 一日，出騎將較勝，歸霸為飛戈所中。
units.en: In a cavalry duel he was struck by a flying halberd.
units.literal: One day he sent out cavalry to contest victory; Guiba was struck by a flying halberd.

units.zh: 即拔馬卻逸，控弦一發，賊洞頸而墜，遂兼騎而還。
units.en: He wheeled, shot the rider through the neck, and seized his horse.
units.literal: He at once pulled his horse back and fled, drew his bow one shot—the bandit pierced through the neck and fell; he then took the horse and returned.

units.zh: 太祖時於高丘下瞰，備見其狀，麵加賞激，厚以金帛及所獲馬錫之。
units.en: The Founder watched from Gaomound and richly rewarded him.
units.literal: The Founder at that time overlooked from Gaomound and fully saw the scene; he added praise and stimulation to his face and richly bestowed gold silks and captured horses.

units.zh: 又嘗被命以控弦之士五百人伏於壕內，太祖統數百騎稍逼其寨，蔡人果以銳士摩壘來追，歸霸發伏兵，掩殺千餘人，奪馬數十匹，尋奏授檢校左散騎常侍。
units.en: His trench ambush killed a thousand Cai pursuers and won him honorary Left Regular Cavalry Attendant.
units.literal: He was also ordered with five hundred archers to lie in ambush in a trench; the Founder with several hundred horse slightly pressed their stockade; Cai men indeed with crack troops rubbed the ramparts in pursuit; Guiba released ambush troops, ambushed and killed more than a thousand, seized several tens of horses, and soon memorialized honorary Left Regular Cavalry Attendant.

units.zh: 其後從太祖伐鄆，副李唐賓渡淮，鹹著奇績。
units.en: He crossed the Huai with Li Tangbin against Yan with striking merit.
units.literal: Afterward he followed the Founder in attacking Yan and as deputy to Li Tangbin crossed the Huai, all showing strange merit.

units.zh: 文德初，大軍臨蔡州，賊將蕭顥來斫寨，歸霸於徐懷玉各以所領兵自東南二扉分出，合勢殺賊，蔡人大敗。
units.en: Wende at Caizhou he and Xu Huaiyu sallied and crushed Xiao Hao.
units.literal: At the beginning of Wende the great army approached Caizhou; bandit general Xiao Hao came to cut the stockade; Guiba with Xu Huaiyu each led their commands out from southeast and second gates, joined force and killed bandits; Cai men were greatly defeated.

units.zh: 及太祖振眾離營，寇塵已息。
units.en: When the Founder left camp the field was already clear.
units.literal: When the Founder rallied the masses and left camp the bandit dust had already settled.

units.zh: 太祖召至，賞之曰：「昔耿弇不俟光武擊張步，言不以賊遺君父，弇之功，爾其二焉。」
units.en: The Founder summoned and rewarded him, saying, "Formerly Geng Yan did not wait for Guangwu to strike Zhang Bu, saying he would not leave bandits to lord and father—Yan's merit; yours is twice it."
units.literal: The Founder summoned him and rewarded him saying: "Formerly Geng Yan did not wait for Guangwu to strike Zhang Bu, saying he would not leave bandits to lord and father—Yan's merit, yours is twice it."

units.zh: 大順中，郭紹賓拔曹州，歸霸率兵數千守之。
units.en: Dashun he garrisoned Cao after Guo Shaobin took it.
units.literal: In Dashun, Guo Shaobin took Cao prefecture; Guiba led several thousand troops to guard it.

units.zh: 俄而朱瑾統大軍自至，歸霸與丁會逆擊之於金鄉，瑾大敗，擒賊將宗江等七十餘人，曹州以寧。
units.en: He and Ding Hui routed Zhu Jin at Jinxiang and captured seventy officers.
units.literal: Soon Zhu Jin led a great army in person; Guiba with Ding Hui met and struck them at Jinxiang; Jin was greatly defeated; bandit generals Zong Jiang and more than seventy men were captured; Cao prefecture was pacified.

units.zh: 明年，破濮州，生擒刺史邵儒。
units.en: Next year he took Pu and captured Shao Ru alive.
units.literal: The next year he took Pu prefecture and captured military commissioner Shao Ru alive.

units.zh: 又佐葛從周與晉軍戰於洹水，生獲克用愛子落落。
units.en: At Huan River he helped capture Keyong's son Luoluo.
units.literal: He again aided Ge Congzhou in fighting Jin troops at Huan River and captured Keyong's beloved son Luoluo alive.

units.zh: 復與燕人戰於內黃，殺仁恭兵三萬餘眾。
units.en: At Neihuang he killed thirty thousand Yan troops.
units.literal: He again fought Yan men at Neihuang and killed more than thirty thousand of Rengong's troops.

units.zh: 戎績超特，居諸將之右，累官至檢校左僕射。
units.en: His merit topped the generals; he reached honorary Left Vice Director.
units.literal: Military achievement exceptionally surpassing, he stood to the right of the generals, successively reaching honorary Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 光化二年，權知邢州事。
units.en: Guanghua 2 he governed Xingzhou provisionally.
units.literal: In Guanghua year 2 he was provisional Xingzhou affairs.

units.zh: 明年春，李嗣昭以蕃漢五萬來寇，歸霸堅壁設備，晉軍不敢顧其城，遂移軍攻洺州，陷焉。
units.en: The following spring, Li Sizhao invaded with fifty thousand tribal and Chinese troops. Guiba fortified Xingzhou and made ready to defend it. The Jin army did not dare assault the city, so it moved on to Mingzhou and captured it instead.
units.literal: The following spring, Li Sizhao invaded with fifty thousand tribal and Chinese troops. Guiba kept behind strong walls and prepared his defenses. The Jin army did not dare attack his city, so it shifted to Ming Prefecture and captured it.

units.zh: 時太祖在滑，頗慮邢之失守。
units.en: The Founder at Hua feared Xing would fall.
units.literal: At that time the Founder was at Hua and quite feared Xing's loss.

units.zh: 及葛從周復洺，嗣昭北遁，歸霸出兵襲之，殺二萬餘眾。
units.en: When Congzhou retook Ming, Guiba ambushed Sizhao and killed twenty thousand.
units.literal: When Ge Congzhou recovered Ming, Sizhao fled north; Guiba led troops in ambush strike and killed more than twenty thousand.

units.zh: 捷至，賞錫殊等，旋以功奏加檢校司空。
units.en: He was richly rewarded and made honorary Grand Marshal.
units.literal: Victory arrived; rewards and gifts were special; soon for merit memorialized added honorary Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 天祐初，遷萊州刺史，秩滿授左衛上將軍，又除曹州刺史。
units.en: Early Tianyou he governed Lai, then became Left Guard general and Cao commissioner.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou he was transferred Laizhou prefect; when term expired he was appointed Left Guard upper general; again made Cao prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 其秋，加檢校司徒，副劉知俊禦邠、鳳之寇，敗之。
units.en: That autumn he helped Liu Zhijun beat Bin and Feng raiders.
units.literal: That autumn he was added honorary Minister of Works, deputy to Liu Zhijun in resisting Bin and Feng raiders, and defeated them.

units.zh: 太祖受禪，拜右龍虎統軍，改左驍衛上將軍，充河陽諸軍都指揮使。
units.en: At the abdication he commanded dragon-tiger and valiant guard troops and Heyang armies.
units.literal: When the Founder received the abdication he was made Right Dragon-Tiger overall commander, changed to Left Valiant Guard upper general, full Heyang all-armies overall commander.

units.zh: 明年夏六月，就除河陽節度使、檢校太保，尋加同平章事。
units.en: Next summer he became Heyang commissioner, Grand Guardian, and chief minister.
units.literal: The next summer, sixth month, he was appointed Heyang military commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian; soon added co-equal chief minister.

units.zh: 二年秋七月，卒於位。
units.en: Year 2, autumn, month 7, he died in office.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn of year 2 he died in office.

units.zh: 詔贈太傅。
units.en: He was posthumously named Grand Tutor.
units.literal: An edict posthumously made him Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 梁末帝德妃張氏，即歸霸女也。
units.en: The Last Emperor's Virtuous Consort Zhang was his daughter.
units.literal: Liang Last Emperor Virtuous Consort Zhang was Guiba's daughter.

units.zh: 末帝嗣位，以歸霸子漢鼎、漢傑並為近職。
units.en: His sons Handing and Hanjie became palace attendants.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor succeeded, Guiba's sons Handing and Hanjie were both made close attendants.

units.zh: 漢鼎早亡，漢傑貞明中為控鶴指揮使，領兵討惠王於陳州，擒之。
units.en: Hanjie captured the Prince of Hui at Chen in Zhenming.
units.literal: Handing died early; in Zhenming Hanjie was Crane-Control commander, led troops to attack Prince of Hui at Chenzhou, and captured him.

units.zh: 當貞明、龍德之際，漢傑昆仲分掌權要，藩鎮除拜多出其門，段凝因之遂竊兵柄。
units.en: The Hanjie brothers dominated appointments until Duan Ning seized the army.
units.literal: During Zhenming and Longde, the Hanjie brothers in turn held crucial power; frontier appointments mostly came from their gate; Duan Ning therefore stole military authority.

units.zh: 及莊宗入汴，漢傑與兄漢倫、弟漢融同日伏誅於汴橋下。
units.en: When Zhuangzong took Bian the three brothers were executed at Bian Bridge.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong entered Bian, Hanjie with elder brother Hanlun and younger brother Hanrong on the same day were executed at Bian Bridge.

units.zh: 張歸厚，字德坤，
units.en: Zhang Guihou, styled Dekun,
units.literal: Zhang Guihou, style name Dekun,

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒考異》引《梁功臣列傳》云：歸厚祖興，父處讓。）〉
units.en: (The 《Mirror Examined》 supplement cites the 《Biographies of Liang Merit Ministers》: grandfather Xing, father Churang.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Mirror Examined》 cites the 《Biographies of Liang Merit Ministers》: Guihou's grandfather Xing, father Churang.)〉

units.zh: 少驍勇，有機略，尤長於弓槊之用。
units.en: Young he was fierce, clever, and master of bow and spear.
units.literal: In youth fierce and brave, had resourcefulness, especially excelled in bow and spear use.

units.zh: 中和末，與兄歸霸自巢軍相率來降，太祖署為軍校。
units.en: Late Zhonghe he surrendered from Chao with Guiba as army officer.
units.literal: At the end of Zhonghe with elder brother Guiba he came from Chao's army in succession to surrender; the Founder appointed him army officer.

units.zh: 時淮西兵力方壯，太祖之師尚寡，歸厚以少擊眾，往無不捷。
units.en: Though few against many, he never lost.
units.literal: At that time Huaixi military power was just strong; the Founder's army was still few; Guihou with few struck many and went nowhere without victory.

units.zh: 光啟三年春，與秦宗賢戰於萬勝，大破之。
units.en: Guangqi 3 spring he crushed Qin Zongxian at Wansheng.
units.literal: In spring of Guangqi year 3 he fought Qin Zongxian at Wansheng and greatly defeated him.

units.zh: 其夏，蔡將張至以數萬眾屯於赤堈，歸厚嘗與至單騎鬥於陣，至不能支而奔，師徒乘此大捷。
units.en: He single-handedly drove off Zhang Zhi at Chijin in a mounted duel.
units.literal: That summer Cai general Zhang Zhi with tens of thousands encamped at Chijin; Guihou once single-horse dueled Zhi in the formation; Zhi could not sustain and fled; the army took this great victory.

units.zh: 太祖大悅，立署為騎軍長，仍以鞍馬器幣錫之。
units.en: The Founder made him cavalry chief and gave him horse and gear.
units.literal: The Founder was greatly pleased, immediately appointed him cavalry army chief, and still bestowed saddle, horse, vessels, and silks.

units.zh: 及佐朱珍討時溥，寨於豐、蕭之間，歸厚乘徐壘如行坦途，甚為諸將歎伏。
units.en: Besieging Shi Pu he crossed Xu walls as if on flat ground.
units.literal: When aiding Zhu Zhen against Shi Pu he stockaded between Feng and Xiao; Guihou crossed Xu ramparts as if on level road—generals deeply sighed in admiration.

units.zh: 龍紀初，奏遷檢校工部尚書。
units.en: Longji he became honorary Minister of Works.
units.literal: At the beginning of Longji he was memorialized transferred honorary Minister of Works.

units.zh: 其年冬，復伐徐，歸厚以偏師徑進，至九里山下與徐兵遇。
units.en: That winter he advanced to Jiuli Mountain against Xu.
units.literal: That winter he again attacked Xu; Guihou with a separate column went straight forward to below Jiuli Mountain and met Xu troops.

units.zh: 時我之叛將陳璠在賊陣中，歸厚忽見之，因瞋目大罵，單馬直往，期於必取，會飛矢中左目而退；
units.en: Seeing rebel Chen Fan he charged alone until an arrow blinded his left eye;
units.literal: At that time our rebel Chen Fan was in the bandit formation; Guihou suddenly saw him, glared and loudly cursed, single horse went straight there intending surely to take him; a flying arrow struck the left eye and he withdrew;

units.zh: 徐戎甚眾，莫敢追之。
units.en: Xu troops dared not pursue.
units.literal: Xu troops were very many; none dared pursue.

units.zh: 大順元年，奏加檢校兵部尚書，又命統親軍。
units.en: Dashun 1 he became honorary Minister of War and commanded the guard.
units.literal: In Dashun year 1 he was memorialized added honorary Minister of War and ordered to command the personal guard.

units.zh: 是歲，郴王遷寨，未知所往，忽逢兗、鄆賊寇甚眾，太祖亟登道左高阜以觀之，命歸厚領所部廳子馬直突之。
units.en: When Yan raiders swarmed he charged with the hall-son horse at the Founder's order.
units.literal: That year Prince of Chen moved stockade, destination unknown; suddenly meeting Yan and Yanzhou bandits very many, the Founder urgently climbed a high mound by the road to observe and ordered Guihou to lead his hall-son horse to charge straight in.

units.zh: 出沒二十餘合，賊大敗將北，而救軍雲至，歸厚即綴賊苦戰，請太祖以數十騎先還。
units.en: After twenty clashes he held the enemy while the Founder escaped with a few horsemen.
units.literal: Emerging and withdrawing more than twenty rounds, bandits were greatly defeated and about to flee north, but rescue troops clouded in; Guihou then fought the bandits bitterly and begged the Founder with several tens of horse to return first.

units.zh: 時歸厚所乘馬中流矢而踣，乃持槊步鬥漸退，賊不敢逼。
units.en: His horse fell; he fought on foot with his spear until the enemy dared not close.
units.literal: At that time Guihou's mounted horse was struck by a flowing arrow and fell; he then held his spear and fought on foot gradually retreating; bandits did not dare press.

units.zh: 太祖至寨，亟命張筠、劉儒飛騎來迎，然謂已歿矣。
units.en: The Founder sent Zhang Yun and Liu Ru to find him, fearing him dead.
units.literal: The Founder reached camp and urgently ordered Zhang Yun and Liu Ru with flying horse to welcome; yet he thought him already dead.

units.zh: 歸厚體被二十餘箭，尚復拒戰，筠等既至，賊解乃歸。
units.en: Wounded by twenty arrows he fought until Yun arrived and the enemy broke.
units.literal: Guihou's body received more than twenty arrows yet still resisted battle; when Yun and the rest arrived bandits dispersed and he returned.

units.zh: 太祖見之，撫背泣下曰：「得歸厚身全，縱廣喪戎馬，何足計乎！」
units.en: The Founder, seeing him, stroked his back and wept, saying, "To get Guihou back whole—even if we lose horses wholesale, what does it matter!"
units.literal: The Founder seeing him stroked his back and wept, saying: "To get Guihou back whole—even if broadly losing army horses, what is worth counting!"

units.zh: 便令肩舁歸汴，日降問賚，恩旨甚厚，尋遷中軍指揮使。
units.en: Carried to Bian he was richly honored and made central army commander.
units.literal: He then ordered him carried on shoulders back to Bian; daily descending inquiries and gifts; imperial favor very thick; soon he was transferred central army commander.

units.zh: 景福初，從太祖伐鄆，帝軍不利，太祖為寇所逼，歸厚殿馬翼衛，左右馳射，矢發如雨，賊騎千百，披靡而退。
units.en: Jingfu he covered the Founder's retreat with arrow storms at Yan.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jingfu following the Founder in attacking Yan the imperial army was unfavorable; the Founder was pressed by bandits; Guihou brought up the rear wing-guarding, left and right galloping and shooting; arrows fell like rain; bandit cavalry by thousands and hundreds collapsed and retreated.

units.zh: 明年，與葛從周禦晉軍於洹水，殊績尤著。
units.en: Next year at Huan River his merit was outstanding.
units.literal: The next year with Ge Congzhou he met Jin troops at Huan River; special merit was especially marked.

units.zh: 詔加檢校右僕射。
units.en: He became honorary Right Vice Director.
units.literal: An edict added honorary Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 其後，討滄州，復洺州，咸以功聞，太祖錄其勳，命權知洺州事。
units.en: After Cang and Ming campaigns he governed Ming provisionally.
units.literal: Afterward attacking Cangzhou and recovering Ming prefecture—all with merit reported—the Founder recorded his merit and ordered him provisional Ming prefecture affairs.

units.zh: 是郡嘗兩為晉人所陷，井邑蕭條，歸厚撫之，數月之內，民庶翕然。
units.en: He restored desolate Ming within months.
units.literal: This prefecture had twice been taken by Jin men; towns and hamlets were desolate; Guihou comforted it; within months the people were harmonious.

units.zh: 太祖自鎮、定還，睹其緝理之政，大喜，賞之。
units.en: The Founder praised his governance on return from Zhen and Ding.
units.literal: The Founder returning from Zhen and Ding saw his governing policy and was greatly pleased and rewarded him.

units.zh: 天復元年冬，真拜洺州刺史，加檢校左僕射，尋授絳州刺史。
units.en: Tianfu 1 winter he became Ming then Jiang commissioner.
units.literal: In winter of Tianfu year 1 he was formally made Ming prefecture military commissioner, added honorary Left Vice Director; soon appointed Jiang prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 三年秋，改晉州刺史，仍檢校司空。
units.en: Year 3 autumn he became Jin commissioner and honorary Grand Marshal.
units.literal: In autumn of year 3 he was changed Jin prefecture military commissioner, still honorary Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 唐帝遷都洛陽，除右神武統軍。
units.en: When the court moved to Luoyang he commanded Right Divine Martial.
units.literal: When Tang emperor moved the capital to Luoyang he was made Right Divine Martial overall commander.

units.zh: 天祐二年，改左羽林統軍，與徐懷玉同守澤州。
units.en: Tianyou 2 he guarded Ze with Xu Huaiyu.
units.literal: In Tianyou year 2 he was changed Left Feathered Forest overall commander and with Xu Huaiyu jointly guarded Ze prefecture.

units.zh: 時晉軍五萬來攻，郡中戎士甚寡，歸厚極力拒守，並軍乃還。
units.en: He held Ze against fifty thousand Jin until they withdrew.
units.literal: At that time fifty thousand Jin troops came to attack; warriors in the prefecture were very few; Guihou exhausted strength holding fast and Jin army then returned.

units.zh: 太祖受禪，加檢校司空。
units.en: At the abdication he became honorary Grand Marshal.
units.literal: When the Founder received the abdication he was added honorary Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 開平二年夏，劉知俊以同州叛，歸厚副楊師厚、劉鄩等討平之。
units.en: Kaiping 2 summer he helped suppress Liu Zhijun at Tong.
units.literal: In summer of Kaiping year 2 Liu Zhijun rebelled at Tongzhou; Guihou as deputy to Yang Shihou and Liu Ye and others suppressed and pacified it.

units.zh: 秋，軍還，授亳州團練使。
units.en: Autumn he became Bozhou training commissioner.
units.literal: In autumn the army returned; he was appointed Bozhou training commissioner.

units.zh: 乾化二年，拜鎮國軍節度使、陝虢等州觀察處置等使。
units.en: Qianhua 2 he became Zhenguo and Shan-Guo commissioner.
units.literal: In Qianhua year 2 he was made Zhenguo military commissioner and Shan-Guo surveillance and disposition commissioner.

units.zh: 明年夏，以疾卒於位。
units.en: Next summer he died in office.
units.literal: The next summer he died of illness in office.

units.zh: 詔贈太師。
units.en: He was posthumously named Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: An edict posthumously made him Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 子漢卿。
units.en: His son was Hanqing.
units.literal: Son Hanqing.

units.zh: 張歸弁，字從冕。
units.en: Zhang Guibian, styled Congmian.
units.literal: Zhang Guibian, style name Congmian.

units.zh: 始與兄歸霸、歸厚同歸於太祖，得署為牙校。
units.en: At first he and his elder brothers Guiba and Guihou together gave allegiance to the Founder, and he was appointed a guard officer.
units.literal: At first with brothers Guiba and Guihou he together returned to the Founder and was appointed guard officer.

units.zh: 時太祖初鎮宣武，屢命歸弁結好於近境，頗得行人之儀。
units.en: When the Founder first held Xuanwu, he repeatedly ordered Guibian to knit good relations with the nearby borders, and he quite obtained the travelers' courtesy.
units.literal: When the Founder first held Xuanwu, he repeatedly ordered Guibian to knit good relations with near borders, quite obtaining travelers' courtesy.

units.zh: 乾寧中，以偏師佐葛從周禦並軍於洹水。
units.en: Qianning he aided Congzhou at Huan River.
units.literal: In Qianning he with a separate column aided Ge Congzhou in meeting Jin troops at Huan River.

units.zh: 光啟中，又佐張存敬與燕人戰於內黃，積前後功，表授檢校工部尚書。
units.en: In Guangqi he again aided Zhang Cunjing in fighting Yan men at Neihuang; accumulating former and later merit, he was memorialized as honorary Minister of Works.
units.literal: In Guangqi he again aided Zhang Cunjing in fighting Yan men at Neihuang; accumulating former and later merit he was memorialized honorary Minister of Works.

units.zh: 大順初，攻討兗、鄆，命歸弁佐衡王友諒屯單父，軍聲大振，尋為齊州指揮使。
units.en: At the beginning of Dashun, when attacking Yan and Yun, he was ordered to aid Prince of Heng Youliang in camping at Shanfu; military prestige greatly shook, and he was soon made Qi prefecture commander.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dashun, attacking Yan and Yun, he was ordered to aid Prince of Heng Youliang to camp at Shanfu; military prestige greatly shook; soon he was Qi prefecture commander.

units.zh: 屬青帥王師範叛，遣將詐為賈人，挽車數十乘，匿兵器於其中，將謀竊發，歸弁察而擒之，州城以寧。
units.en: He foiled Wang Shifan's merchants smuggling arms into Qi.
units.literal: When Qing commander Wang Shifan rebelled he sent generals feigning merchants, several tens of carts, hiding weapons within, intending to steal a sudden outbreak; Guibian detected and captured them; the prefectural city was thereby pacified.

units.zh: 明年春，青寇大舉來伐，州兵既寡，民意頗搖，有本郡都將。
units.en: Next spring Qing attacked; the city wavered when officers plotted treason.
units.literal: The next spring Qing raiders came in great force to attack; prefectural troops were few and popular hearts somewhat shaken; there were native-command officers.

units.zh: 康文爽等三人欲謀外應，即時擒獲誅之，人心遂定。
units.en: Kang Wenshuang and two others—three in all—wished to plot an outer response; he at once captured and executed them; popular hearts were then settled.
units.literal: Kang Wenshuang and three others wished to plot outer response; he at once captured and executed them; popular hearts were then settled.

units.zh: 歸弁又罄發私帑，賞給士伍，青州平，超加檢校右僕射，遙領愛州刺史。
units.en: He spent his own treasury on the troops; after Qing fell he became honorary Right Vice Director.
units.literal: Guibian also exhausted his private stores to reward and give to soldiers; Qing was pacified; he was specially added honorary Right Vice Director, holding Ai prefecture military commission at a distance.

units.zh: 從征荊、襄回，轉檢校左僕射。
units.en: After Jing and Xiang he became honorary Left Vice Director.
units.literal: Returning from campaigning in Jing and Xiang he was transferred honorary Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 天祐三年春，太祖入魏誅牙軍，魏之郡邑多叛，歸弁與諸將等分布攻討，封境悉平。
units.en: Tianyou 3 spring he helped pacify Wei after the guard massacre.
units.literal: In spring of Tianyou year 3 the Founder entered Wei and executed the guard army; Wei's prefectures and districts mostly rebelled; Guibian with generals and others separately distributed attack and suppression; the sealed borders were all pacified.

units.zh: 而歸弁於高唐攻賊太猛，飛矢中於臆，太祖嘉之，命賜鞍勒馬一匹、金帶一條。
units.en: Wounded storming Gaotang he won a horse and gold belt from the Founder.
units.literal: Yet Guibian at Gaotang attacked bandits too fiercely; a flying arrow struck his chest; the Founder praised it and ordered bestowed one saddle, bridle, and horse, one gold belt.

units.zh: 夏五月，命權知晉州。
units.en: Summer month 5 he acted as Jin commissioner.
units.literal: In the fifth month of summer he was ordered provisional Jin prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 冬十一月，真授晉州刺史，加檢校司空。
units.en: In the eleventh month of winter he was formally appointed Jin prefecture military commissioner and added honorary Director of Works.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of winter he was formally appointed Jin prefecture military commissioner, added honorary Director of Works.

units.zh: 太祖受禪，改滑州長劍指揮使。
units.en: At the abdication he commanded Huazhou long-sword troops.
units.literal: When the Founder received the abdication he was changed Huazhou long-sword commander.

units.zh: 開平二年秋九月，並軍圍平陽，詔歸弁統兵救之。
units.en: Kaiping 2 autumn he relieved besieged Pingyang.
units.literal: In the ninth month of autumn of Kaiping year 2 Jin troops besieged Pingyang; an edict ordered Guibian to lead troops to rescue.

units.zh: 軍至，解其圍，加檢校司徒。
units.en: When the army arrived it lifted the encirclement; he was added honorary Minister over the Masses.
units.literal: When the army arrived it lifted the encirclement; he was added honorary Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 三年春三月，寢疾，卒於滑州之私第。
units.en: Year 3 spring he died at his Huazhou home.
units.literal: In the third month of spring of year 3 he fell ill in bed and died at his private residence in Huazhou.

units.zh: 子漢融。
units.en: His son was Hanrong.
units.literal: Son Hanrong.

units.zh: 史臣曰：從周以驍武之才，事雄猜之主，而能取功名於馬上，啟手足於牖下，靜而言之，斯為賢矣！
units.en: The historian praises Congzhou for serving a suspicious lord yet dying in honor.
units.literal: The historian says: Congzhou with fierce martial talent served a heroically suspicious lord, yet could take fame and achievement on horseback and open hands and feet below the window—in calm speech, this is worthy.

units.zh: 彥章蔚有將才，死於讒口，身既歿矣，國亦隨之，惜哉！
units.en: Yanzhang's murder doomed the state—pity!
units.literal: Yanzhang had abundant general talent yet died at slander's mouth; body already perished, state also followed—pity!

units.zh: 歸霸昆仲，皆脫身於巨盜之流，宣力於興王之運。
units.en: The Zhang brothers left banditry to build the Liang dynasty.
units.literal: The Guiba brothers all escaped from great bandit streams and displayed strength in the rising-king's fortune.

units.zh: 由介胄而析圭爵，可不謂壯夫歟！
units.en: From soldiers to nobles—they were true stalwarts!
units.literal: From armor and helmet to split tallies and ranks—can they not be called stalwart men!

units.zh: 是日，燕人大敗，斬首五萬級，生擒馬慎交已下一百餘人，獲馬萬餘蹄。
units.en: That day the Yan army was shattered: fifty thousand heads, more than a hundred captives led by Ma Shenjiao, and over ten thousand horses.
units.literal: That day the Yan men were greatly defeated; heads cut numbered fifty thousand; alive captured Ma Shenjiao and over a hundred below him; horses obtained over ten thousand hooves.

units.zh: 梁攻時溥，歸厚以麾下先進九里山，遇徐兵而戰，梁故將陳璠叛在徐，歸厚望見識之，瞋目大罵，馳騎直往取之，矢中其左目。
units.en: In Liang’s assault on Shi Pu, Guihou led the van at Jiuli Mountain and met Xu troops; Chen Fan, a former Liang general now at Xu, was spotted—Guihou glared, cursed, and spurred straight at him; an arrow took his left eye.
units.literal: Liang attacked Shi Pu; Guihou led his troops ahead at Jiuli Mountain, met Xu troops and fought; former Liang general Chen Fan had rebelled and was at Xu; Guihou saw and recognized him, glared and cursed, charged straight at him, and an arrow struck his left eye.

units.zh: 友能走保陳州，詔張漢傑率兵進討。
units.en: You Neng shut himself in Chenzhou; Zhang Hanjie was ordered to besiege him.
units.literal: You Neng fled to hold Chenzhou; an edict ordered Zhang Hanjie to lead troops forward to attack.

units.zh: 其行營將士賞賚已給付本家，宜令招討使霍彥威、副招討使王彥章、陳州行營都指揮使張漢傑曉示諸軍知委。」
units.en: Campaign bonuses sent to soldiers’ families should be announced by Huo Yanwei, Wang Yanzhang, and Zhang Hanjie."
units.literal: Campaign soldiers’ rewards already paid to their families—the Pacification commissioner Huo Yanwei, deputy Pacification commissioner Wang Yanzhang, and Chenzhou campaign commander-in-chief Zhang Hanjie should announce to all armies for their knowledge."

units.zh: 甲戌，唐帝引師襲中都，王彥章兵潰，於是彥章與監軍張漢傑及趙廷隱、劉嗣彬、李知節、唐文通、王山興等皆為唐人所獲。
units.en: On jiaxu the Tang emperor stormed Zhongdu; Yanzhang’s army broke; he, Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, and others were taken.
units.literal: On jiaxu the Tang Emperor led troops to strike Zhongdu; Wang Yanzhang’s army collapsed; thereupon Yanzhang, army supervisor Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, Liu Sibin, Li Zhijie, Tang Wentong, Wang Shanxing, and others were all captured by Tang men.

units.zh: 得孫亢、卓環、劉儒、張鄰等，賞有差。」
units.en: for Sun Kang, Zhuo Huan, Liu Ru, Zhang Lin, and the rest, graded rewards."
units.literal: whoever gets Sun Kang, Zhuo Huan, Liu Ru, Zhang Lin, and others—rewards in varying amounts."

units.zh: 李讜，河中臨晉人。
units.en: Li Dang came from Linjin in Hezhong.
units.literal: Li Dang was a native of Linjin in Hezhong.

units.zh: 唐廣明初，黃巢陷長安，讜遂得仕於其間。
units.en: Early in Guangming of Tang, when Huang Chao took Chang'an, Dang entered his service.
units.literal: Tang Guangming early, Huang Chao took Chang'an; Dang then obtained office among them.

units.zh: 讜頗違節度，久而無功。
units.en: Dang disobeyed orders and after a long while had nothing to show.
units.literal: Dang quite violated command; for long had no merit.

units.zh: 巢以讜為內樞密使，蓋讜曾委質於宦者，出入於宮禁間，巢以此用焉。
units.en: Chao made him inner privy commissioner, for Dang had once served eunuchs and knew the palace—Chao used him for that.
units.literal: Chao made Dang inner privy commissioner; because Dang had once placed himself under eunuchs and went in and out of palace confines—Chao used him thus.

units.zh: 其後巢軍既敗，讜乃束身歸於太祖，署為左德勝騎軍都將。
units.en: After Chao's defeat Dang surrendered to the Founder and was made commander of the Left Victorious Virtue cavalry.
units.literal: After Chao's army was defeated Dang bound himself and returned to the Founder; appointed Left Victorious Virtue cavalry commander.

units.zh: 及東伐兗、鄆，以所部士伍俘獲甚眾，改元從騎將，表授檢校右僕射。
units.en: In the eastern campaigns against Yan and Yun his men took many prisoners; he became a yuancong cavalry general and Acting Right Vice Director.
units.literal: And east attacking Yan and Yun, with his command's soldiers captured very many; changed to yuancong cavalry general; memorialized Acting Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 太祖遣追還，廷責其罪，戮之於河橋。
units.en: The Founder recalled him, rebuked him at court, and executed him at He Bridge.
units.literal: The Founder sent to recall him; at court blamed his crime; executed him at He Bridge.

units.zh: 從太祖討蔡賊，頗立軍功。
units.en: He followed the Founder against the Cai rebels and won solid merit.
units.literal: Following the Founder against Cai bandits, considerably established military merit.

units.zh: 郴王友裕領兵攻澤州，時太祖駐大軍於盟津，乃令讜將兵越太行，授以籌謀。
units.en: When Prince of Chen Youyu besieged Zezhou the Founder camped at Meng Ford and sent Dang across the Taihang with full discretion over the plan.
units.literal: Prince of Chen Youyu led troops to attack Zezhou; the Founder then stationed great army at Meng Ford; then ordered Dang to lead troops across Taihang; entrusted with planning.

units.zh: 少時遊秦、雍間，為人勇悍多力，甚有氣誼。
units.en: In youth he wandered Qin and Yong; bold, fierce, and strong, he was famed for loyalty among friends.
units.literal: In youth he roamed Qin and Yong regions; as a man brave, fierce, and very strong, greatly had chivalrous friendship.

units.zh: 帝聞中都之敗，唐軍長驅將至，遣張漢倫馳驛召段凝於河上；
units.en: Hearing of Zhongdu’s fall and Tang’s advance, the Emperor dispatched Zhang Hanlun to recall Duan Ning from the river;
units.literal: The Emperor heard of Zhongdu’s defeat and that Tang troops were coming at speed; he sent Zhang Hanlun by post relay to summon Duan Ning on the river;

units.zh: 漢倫墜馬傷足，復限水潦，不能進。
units.en: Hanlun fell, injured his foot, and floods blocked him.
units.literal: Hanlun fell from his horse and injured his foot; again limited by floods, he could not advance.

units.zh: 謝瞳，字子明，福州人。
units.en: Xie Tong, who styled himself Ziming, came from Fuzhou.
units.literal: Xie Tong, styled Ziming, was a man of Fuzhou.

units.zh: 王重榮表瞳為檢校屯田員外郎，賜緋，令奉表於蜀。
units.en: Wang Chongrong made Tong acting Director of the Palace Farms, dressed him in crimson, and sent him to present the submission to Shu.
units.literal: Wang Chongrong memorialized Tong as acting Director of Palace Farms, granted him crimson robes, and ordered him to present a memorial in Shu.

units.zh: 唐僖宗大悅，召入顧問，錫賚甚厚，以功授朝散大夫、太子率更令，賜紫，為陵州刺史。
units.en: Xizong rejoiced, called him in for counsel, heaped gifts upon him, and for his service made him Grand Master of the Palace and Director of the Crown Prince's water clocks, clothed him in purple, and gave him Lingzhou.
units.literal: Tang Emperor Xizong was greatly pleased, summoned him for consultation, bestowed gifts very generously, and for merit appointed him Grand Master of the Palace, Crown Prince's Director of Water Clocks, granted purple, and made him prefect of Ling.

units.zh: 龍紀二年，至東京，勞徠彌厚，賜第墅各一區，錢千緡，表為亳州團練使兼太清宮副使，加檢校工部尚書。
units.en: In Longji 2 he reached the Eastern Capital; the Founder received him with exceptional honors—a mansion, a country villa, a thousand strings of cash—and memorialized him Bozhou regimental commissioner and deputy head of the Grand Pure Palace, with acting rank as Minister of Works.
units.literal: Longji year 2, he reached the Eastern Capital; rewards and comfort were thicker still, granted one ward each of mansion and villa, a thousand strings of cash, memorialized as Bozhou regimental commissioner and vice-director of the Grand Pure Palace, added acting Minister of Works.

units.zh: 是年冬，太祖征淮南，過郡，因求侍府幕，表為宣義軍節度副使，充兩使留後。
units.en: That winter, as the Founder marched on Huainan and passed through his circuit, Tong asked to join his staff and was made vice-commissioner of the Xuanyi army and regent for both civil and military commissioners.
units.literal: That winter the Founder campaigned against Huainan, passed through his prefecture; he therefore asked to serve in the commandery staff, was memorialized as vice-commissioner of the Xuanyi army and acting regent for both commissioners.

units.zh: 瞳在滑十三年，部內增戶約五萬，益兵數千人，累遷至大中大夫、檢校右僕射，卒於滑。
units.en: Thirteen years at Hua added fifty thousand households and several thousand troops to his circuit; he rose to Grand Master and acting Right Vice Director, and died there.
units.literal: Tong was at Hua thirteen years; within his circuit households increased by about fifty thousand, troops increased by several thousand; he rose in succession to Grand Master and acting Right Vice Director, and died at Hua.

units.zh: 唐咸通末舉進士，因留長安，三歲不中第。
units.en: Late in Xiantong he sat the jinshi examination and stayed in Chang'an; three years passed without his name on the rolls.
units.literal: At the end of Tang Xiantong he sat the jinshi examination and remained in Chang'an; for three years he failed to place.

units.zh: 廣明初，黃巢陷長安，遂投跡於太祖，洎居門下，未嘗一日不在左右。
units.en: When Huang Chao seized Chang'an in the first year of Guangming, Tong entered the Founder's service and from that day was never far from his side.
units.literal: Early Guangming, Huang Chao took Chang'an; he then cast his lot with the Founder, and once under his gate never a day was absent from his side.

units.zh: 開平初，追贈司徒。
units.en: At the opening of Kaiping he was posthumously named Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: Early Kaiping he was posthumously given Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 瞳揣太祖有擇福意，乃進說曰：「黃家以數十萬之師，值唐朝久安，人不習戰，因利乘便，遂下兩京。
units.en: Reading the Founder's wish to change sides, Tong urged him: "Huang's army of hundreds of thousands took both capitals only because the Tang had grown soft in long peace and men had forgotten war.
units.literal: Tong gauged that the Founder intended to choose fortune, and thereupon advanced counsel, saying: "The Huang house with an army of hundreds of thousands, encountering the Tang's long peace and men unpractised in war, rode advantage and seized both capitals.

units.zh: 然始竊偽號，任用已失其所。
units.en: Yet the moment they claimed an emperor's title, every appointment went wrong.
units.literal: Yet having first stolen a false title, their appointments already miss their place.

units.zh: 今將軍勇冠三軍，力戰於外，而孟楷專務壅蔽，奏章不達，下為庸才所製，無獨斷之明，破亡之兆必矣。
units.en: You fight abroad with unmatched courage while Meng Kai chokes every letter to court; mediocrities below him run the show, and without firm command ruin is certain.
units.literal: Now the general's courage crowns the three armies, fighting hard abroad, yet Meng Kai devotes himself to blocking; memorials do not arrive, below he is constrained by mediocrities and lacks the clarity of sole decision—the omen of ruin is sure.

units.zh: 況土德未厭，外兵四集，漕運波注，日以收復為名，惟將軍察之。」
units.en: Heaven's mandate still favors the Tang: armies close from every quarter, grain fleets pour in, and every day another force marches to restore the throne—think on that, General."
units.literal: Moreover earth's virtue is not yet spent; armies gather from four sides, grain-ships pour in waves, day by day they march under the name of restoration—only let the general consider it."

units.zh: 太祖曰：「我意素決，爾又如是，復何疑哉！」
units.en: The Founder replied, "My mind was made long ago; hearing you say the same, what doubt could remain?"
units.literal: The Founder said: "My mind was long settled; you speak thus too—what doubt remains!"

units.zh: 及太祖據同州，遂署右職。
units.en: Once the Founder held Tongzhou, he gave Tong a chief post on his staff.
units.literal: When the Founder held Tong Prefecture, he then appointed him to a right-hand post.

units.zh: 北面招討使賀瑰殺許州節度使謝彥章、濮州刺史孟審澄、別將侯溫裕等於軍，以謀叛聞，為行營馬步都虞候朱珪構之也。
units.en: Northern Pacification Commissioner He Gui executed Xie Yanzhang, military governor of Xu Prefecture, Meng Shencheng, prefect of Pu Prefecture, detached general Hou Wenyü, and others in the army, reporting them for plotting rebellion; Zhu Gui, line-camp horse-and-foot chief of staff, had framed them.
units.literal: Northern Pacification commissioner He Gui killed at the army Xu military commissioner Xie Yanzhang, Pu prefect Meng Shencheng, detached general Hou Wenyü, and others, reporting a plot to rebel—it was framed by line-camp horse-and-foot chief of staff Zhu Gui.

units.zh: 而謝彥章、孟審澄、侯溫裕忽構異圖，將萌逆節，賴朱珪挺施貞節，密運沈機，果致梟擒，免資仇敵。
units.en: Then Yanzhang, Shencheng, and Wenyü plotted treason; Zhu Gui's loyalty and secret planning captured them before they could aid the foe.
units.literal: Yet Xie Yanzhang, Meng Shencheng, and Hou Wenyü suddenly formed a different design and were about to sprout treason; relying on Zhu Gui's upright conduct and secret deep planning, they were indeed captured and the enemy was denied their use.

units.zh: 癸丑，詔曰：「行營諸軍馬步都虞候、匡國軍節度觀察留後朱珪，昨以寇戎未滅，兵革方嚴，所期朝夕之間，克弭煙塵之患，每於將帥，別注憂勞。
units.en: On guichou the court proclaimed: "Zhu Gui, line-camp chief and Kuangguo commissioner—while the foe remained and war was fierce we expected victory any day and watched our generals closely.
units.literal: On guichou an edict stated: "Line-camp horse-and-foot chief of staff and Kuangguo observation commissioner Zhu Gui—yesterday, with the border foe not yet destroyed and arms still stern, we looked to settle the dust within days and nights and set special care on the generals.

units.zh: 特加異殊之命，用旌忠孝之謀，便委雄藩，俾荷隆渥。
units.en: Extraordinary honors signal his loyalty; a great frontier post rewards him.
units.literal: A special extraordinary appointment is added to signal loyal and filial counsel; he is entrusted with a great frontier post to bear heavy grace.

units.zh: 可檢校太傅，充平盧軍節度、淄青登萊等州觀察處置、押新羅渤海兩番等使兼行營諸軍馬步軍副都指揮使，仍進封沛國郡開國侯。」
units.en: Let him be honorary Grand Mentor, Pinglu commissioner over the eastern coast, envoy to Silla and Bohai, deputy commander of line-camp horse and foot, and Marquis of Pei."
units.literal: He may be honorary Grand Mentor, Pinglu Army military commissioner and observation and disposition commissioner for Zi, Qing, Deng, and Lai, commissioner for the two missions to Silla and Bohai, and deputy commander of all line-camp horse-and-foot forces, still advanced to Marquis of Pei Commandery."

units.zh: 其後破盧瑭、張至及朱瑄、朱瑾之眾，平定曹、濮，未嘗不在戰中。
units.en: He fought Lu Tang, Zhang Zhi, Zhu Xuan, and Zhu Jin, pacified Cao and Pu, and was never far from the fighting.
units.literal: Afterward he broke the hosts of Lu Tang, Zhang Zhi, Zhu Xuan, and Zhu Jin, pacified Cao and Pu—never absent from battle.
